text: The purpose of this report is to provide a marketing overview of the Broadway shows and the Mandela Exhibition for the fourth quarter of 2019.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 15, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety because if disclosed could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons, or organization.
